title: Assyafaah Community Sunnah Festival 2026
description: A community festival featuring programmes, activities, community booths, and family-oriented experiences centred on the Sunnah.

uncertainties: Programme details, registration, and pricing were not provided.

sources.caption:
Something special is coming to Assyafaah! ✨🌿
A day to come together as a community, reconnect with the Sunnah, and enjoy meaningful experiences for the whole family.
From inspiring programmes to engaging activities, community booths and more — there’s something for everyone at the Assyafaah Community Sunnah Festival 2026!
🗓 Sunday, 15 November 2026
⏰ 8:00am – 4:00pm
📍 Assyafaah Mosque
Save the date and keep a lookout!
More exciting details will be revealed soon, insyaAllah!
⸻
Sesuatu yang istimewa bakal berlangsung di Assyafaah! ✨🌿
Jom luangkan sehari bersama keluarga dan masyarakat, sambil kita mendekati, mengenali dan menghidupkan Sunnah dalam kehidupan seharian.
Pelbagai pengisian menarik, aktiviti, reruai komuniti dan banyak lagi menanti anda di Assyafaah Community Sunnah Festival 2026!
🗓 Ahad, 15 November 2026
⏰ 8:00 pagi – 4:00 petang
📍 Masjid Assyafaah
Tempah tarikh ini dan nantikan perkongsian seterusnya!
Banyak lagi yang bakal diumumkan, insyaAllah!
